about: Hand-authored ground truth for bench/bench_overlap_gate.py. One entry per finding at or above the sweep floor (15 words) in the references-masked arm. `label` is whether an overlap_gate blocking this finding would be right: `tp` = genuine uncredited reuse a reviewer would require fixing, `fp` = a finding no reviewer would act on. Rationales carry no extended verbatim text; the passages are locatable from `draft` and `line` in overlap_gate.json.

corpus.note: finding ids are sha256(citekey, page, fragment), so a re-parse or a page shift invalidates this file rather than silently half-matching it. bench_overlap_gate.py reports labels that match no current finding as an integrity complaint.

finding_classes.canonical-definition: The passage is a standard's or a field's fixed definition. The draft attributes it in prose and cites a source for it; the matched paper is quoting the same definition. Not reuse of that paper's own writing.
finding_classes.third-party-echo: A canonical-definition match against a paper *other* than the one the draft cites. The draft can only cite one source for a definition that many corpus papers reproduce, so every other one reports as UNCITED SOURCE. `cites_source` cannot distinguish this from real uncredited reuse.
finding_classes.attributed-quotation: Quoted with quote marks or as a blockquote, and attributed. Legitimate scholarship.

6dec39addc4a.label: fp
6dec39addc4a.rationale: The VanDerHorn & Mahadevan consolidated definition of a digital twin. The draft attributes it in prose ('A generalisation exercise across the published definitions proposes') and cites vanderhorn_digital_2021. thelen_comprehensive_2022 p.3 quotes the same definition and names its authors; the match is against Thelen's quotation of someone else's words, not Thelen's own.

e308b2d5b2b2.label: fp
e308b2d5b2b2.rationale: Same passage and same reasoning as 6dec39addc4a; the corpus holds thelen_comprehensive_2022 twice, so one draft sentence yields two findings. Duplicate corpus entries inflate any count taken over findings rather than over passages.

777c622bef3b.label: fp
777c622bef3b.rationale: The same VanDerHorn definition, matched against vanderhorn_digital_2021 itself -- the paper the draft actually cites (cites_source=true). Attributed in prose and correctly credited; the only criticism available is that a definition quoted this closely could carry quotation marks.

27903edc179b.label: fp
27903edc179b.rationale: ISO 23247's definition of a digital twin for manufacturing, under the draft's own heading '2.5.2 ISO 23247's', attributed in prose ('The manufacturing standard defines a digital twin as') and cited to bottjer_review_2023-1. Reproducing a standard's definition is what quoting a standard is.

eb96275fcf8f.label: fp
eb96275fcf8f.rationale: The ISO 23247 definition again, matched against anwer_developing_2025, which quotes the standard rather than being its source. The draft cites bottjer_review_2023-1 for it, so this reports UNCITED SOURCE despite the definition being credited.

5a53197e4b75.label: fp
5a53197e4b75.rationale: As eb96275fcf8f; anwer_developing_2025 is in the corpus twice.

5872358f0f2d.label: fp
5872358f0f2d.rationale: The ISO 23247 definition matched against paredis_family_2023, which quotes it in quote marks and names the standard ('Systems and integration - Digital twin framework for manufacturing defines a DT for manufacturing as ...'). Verified in the parsed source text.

1e13c0722790.label: fp
1e13c0722790.rationale: Kritzinger's digital model / shadow / twin taxonomy, set as a Markdown blockquote and cited to kritzinger_digital_2018 -- the work that first stated it. The match is against barbie_toward_2024, which reproduces the same taxonomy. quoted=true but cites_source=false, so _bucket keeps it in `long` and #130's predicate does NOT exempt it: this is the concrete case where a correctly quoted, correctly credited passage would still block.

8bf9f6405db5.label: fp
8bf9f6405db5.rationale: The adjacent blockquote in the same taxonomy, same reasoning as 1e13c0722790.

777c28fe9fc9.label: fp
777c28fe9fc9.rationale: The ISO 23247 definition where chapter 13 restates it, cited to bottjer_review_2023-1. The same canonical sentence appearing in two chapters of one book produces findings in both.

203c7274dc73.label: fp
203c7274dc73.rationale: A quoted and cited sentence from ferko_standardisation_2023. severity=quoted, so #130's predicate exempts it and it can never block -- recorded to keep the exempt population visible rather than absent.

80da31839d85.label: fp

4b3e157b920b.label: fp
4b3e157b920b.rationale: ISO 23247 definition in chapter 13, matched against paredis_family_2023's quotation of the standard.
